description: Angular component for the notes page, managing notes display, editing, creation, and deletion with interaction with NotesService.

classes.name: NotesPage
classes.description: Angular component class for the notes page, handling user interactions and data binding for notes.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches list of notes from the NotesService based on current query.

methods.name: onSelect
methods.description: Sets the selected note and opens the editor.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Saves a new or updated note via the NotesService.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Deletes a note via the NotesService.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Removes event listener on component destruction.
